LESSON: ANIMALS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and its
Topic 1.6: Animals resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Animals resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate diversity of animals in the immediate environment. animals that they observed animals for enjoyment information on animals from parents or guardians.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate diversity of animals in the immediate environment. animals that they observed animals for enjoyment information on animals from parents or guardians.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate diversity of animals in the immediate environment. animals that they observed animals for enjoyment information on animals from parents or guardians. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Animals resources.
2. Explain Animals resources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Animals resources.
4. Show that you can: appreciate diversity of animals in the immediate environment. animals that they observed animals for enjoyment information on animals from parents or guardians.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Animals resources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Animals resources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate diversity of animals in the immediate environment. animals that they observed animals for enjoyment information on animals from parents or guardians.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
